backup_odb_subnet.rationale: Backup subnet selection affects network isolation and determines where backup traffic flows.

backup_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR range of the backup subnet.
backup_subnet_cidr.rationale: CIDR ranges must be restricted to private, non-public IP space to prevent exposure of backup traffic.

cidr.description: Network settings. CIDR to use for cluster IP allocation.
cidr.rationale: Cluster IP allocation must use private ranges to avoid public exposure of database nodes.

cloud_vm_cluster_id.description:
The ID of the VM Cluster to create. This value is restricted
to (^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$) and must be a maximum of 63
characters in length. The value must start with a letter and end with
a letter or a number.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Deletion policies protect critical infrastructure from accidental removal.

deletion_protection.description: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the cluster. Deleting this cluster via terraform destroy or terraform apply will only succeed if this field is false in the Terraform state.
deletion_protection.rationale: Deletion protection prevents accidental destruction of production database clusters.

display_name.description: User friendly name for this resource.

labels.description:
Labels or tags associated with the VM Cluster. 

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. See documentation for resource type 'oracledatabase.googleapis.com/DbNode'.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

network.description:
The name of the VPC network.
Format: projects/{project}/global/networks/{network}
network.rationale: Network selection determines isolation boundaries and must reference private VPCs.

odb_network.description:
The name of the OdbNetwork associated with the VM Cluster.
Format:
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odb_network}
It is optional but if specified, this should match the parent ODBNetwork of
the odb_subnet and backup_odb_subnet.
odb_network.rationale: ODB network selection affects routing and isolation of database traffic.

odb_subnet.rationale: Subnet selection determines IP allocation and must remain private.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

properties.description: Various properties and settings associated with Exadata VM cluster.

properties.data_storage_size_tb.description: The data disk group size to be allocated in TBs.

properties.disk_redundancy.description:
The type of redundancy. 
 Possible values:
 DISK_REDUNDANCY_UNSPECIFIED
HIGH
NORMAL
properties.disk_redundancy.rationale: Disk redundancy affects resilience and fault tolerance of stored data.

properties.hostname_prefix.description: Prefix for VM cluster host names.

properties.license_type.description:
License type of VM Cluster. 
 Possible values:
 LICENSE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
LICENSE_INCLUDED
BRING_YOUR_OWN_LICENSE

properties.local_backup_enabled.rationale: Local backups must be controlled to avoid storing sensitive data in insecure locations.

properties.ocpu_count.description: OCPU count per VM. Minimum is 0.1.

properties.sparse_diskgroup_enabled.rationale: Sparse disk groups affect snapshot behaviour and data recovery paths.

properties.ssh_public_keys.description: SSH public keys to be stored with cluster.
properties.ssh_public_keys.rationale: SSH keys directly control administrative access to the cluster.

properties.diagnostics_data_collection_o.description: Indicates whether diagnostic collection is enabled for the VM cluster
properties.diagnostics_data_collection_o.rationale: Diagnostic event collection may expose operational metadata and must be explicitly controlled.

properties.diagnostics_data_collection_o.description: Indicates whether health monitoring is enabled for the VM cluster
properties.diagnostics_data_collection_o.rationale: Health monitoring can expose sensitive system metrics and should be enabled only in approved configurations.

properties.diagnostics_data_collection_o.description:
Indicates whether incident logs and trace collection are enabled for the VM
cluster
properties.diagnostics_data_collection_o.rationale: Incident logs may contain sensitive operational or security information and must be tightly controlled.

properties.time_zone.description:
Represents a time zone from the
[IANA Time Zone Database](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

properties.time_zone.id.description: IANA Time Zone Database time zone, e.g. "America/New_York".

properties.time_zone.version.description: IANA Time Zone Database version number, e.g. "2019a".
